The type of collaboration that is best for a firm is determined by the firm's strategy and its knowledge of what it can contribute and what it needs to innovate.
the type of collaborative arrangement that works best is the one that best matches the type of innovation that the partners are pursuing.
the choice of the type of collaboration depends on the type of innovation, on the type of resources required, on the type and level of uncertainty and on the type of governance.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the question of how to organize innovation in the presence of external partners.
the role of different types of collaboration in innovation.
understanding the nature of the relationships between firms, universities, and research institutes, and their effects on the innovative performance of firms.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
a closed, flat governance system is the most effective type of collaboration for a company to pursue in order to maximize their innovation efforts.
collaboration is a key element to innovation.
a company's collaboration should be based on the type of innovation that the company wants to achieve.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
collaboration can be a very powerful tool to drive innovation, but it is also very risky.
the most successful innovation efforts are the result of collaboration between the right people, in the right way, for the right reasons, and for the right amount of time.
there is no one size fits all.
The main takeaway from our work is that
there is no single best type of collaboration for every situation.
companies need to be clear about their strategy and their capabilities before they decide which type of collaboration is best for them.
the type of collaboration matters, and that it is not just a matter of open versus closed.
